name: TrackingMore
tagline: Global multi-carrier package tracking API for logistics apps.
description: TrackingMore is a multi-carrier shipment tracking API that aggregates package status from hundreds of couriers worldwide. Developers use it to create trackings, poll delivery status, receive webhooks, and surface last-mile updates in ecommerce, logistics, and support tools without integrating each carrier separately.

auth.details: API key via Tracking-Api-Key header (self-serve signup). Some docs also show Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — verify on pricing page; historically freemium with limited trackings

use_cases: get delivery status for a package tracking number
create multi-carrier shipment tracking for an order
list recent trackings for a logistics dashboard
detect courier from a tracking number
receive webhook updates when package status changes
